comment: Map/render verification boot for green_flat_x34_v3 — one of the two maps in the imported set that exercise the PLAIN detail branch of SMFFragProg (mapinfo declares resources.detailTex only: no splatDetailTex, no splatDetailNormalTexN), so the client's TerrainSplat plugin must report mode='plain'. That branch shipped in PLAN-maps M7a and had no live cover until this manifest. Square map, 17408 elmos, six start positions, no features. No scenario on purpose: this boots the game_start stub force so it stays a pure terrain/minimap check independent of war content. A copy of this file must also live in client/public/ — that, not manifests/, is what ?direct= fetches (M8b finding 4).
name: dev:green-flat-verify-solo
